boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten distinct University of Nevada, Reno destinations for studying, making, collaborating, and campus life.

cards.title: Joe Crowley Student Union
cards.subtitle: Study nooks, lounges, services, and gathering space
cards.notes: Start here when your group needs a central meeting point: use the lounge or quiet-study areas, then check the building directory for services and rooms.
cards.short_summary: The student union combines study areas, gathering space, dining, and campus services.
cards.evidence_claim: The Union describes itself as offering study spaces, event and meeting spaces, lounge seating, quiet study areas, and essential student services.
cards.source_title: Joe Crowley Student Union | University of Nevada, Reno
cards.access_notes: Use current building hours shown on the Union page; walk-up study rooms are available upon request.

cards.title: Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.subtitle: Main campus library for solo and group work
cards.notes: Use the floor maps to choose a setting before you arrive: the building has general study, collaboration, collection, computer, and printing areas.
cards.short_summary: The Knowledge Center is the main library with mapped study and collaboration space across several floors.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says the Knowledge Center includes general study and collaboration spaces for group or solo projects.
cards.source_title: Knowledge Center floor maps | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check library access and service information before visiting; some rooms and services have separate conditions.

cards.title: Chase Tower Reading Room
cards.subtitle: MIKC 300, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Choose this named reading room for focused work with table lamps and window light; keep noise low so the restricted-noise setting works for others.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Knowledge Center reading room with controlled noise expectations and adjustable light conditions.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries lists MIKC 300 Chase Tower Reading Room as a restricted-noise space with table lamps and large windows.
cards.access_notes: Located in MIKC room 300; follow the library's restricted-noise guidance.

cards.title: MIKC Fifth Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center
cards.notes: Head to the fifth floor when you need a quieter independent-work setting; use the available carrels or tables and leave group discussion for another area.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study floor with carrels, tables, printers, and group rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries identifies the Knowledge Center fifth floor as a quiet study floor with restricted noise levels, study carrels, and four group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Knowledge Center's fifth floor; observe restricted noise levels.

cards.title: DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: Mackay Mines Building, just off the historic Quad
cards.notes: Bring a STEM project or research question here: pair the library’s study environment with its data, GIS, map, and technology support services.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich science and engineering library with study, data, mapping, and making resources.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries describes DeLaMare as a technology-rich library with user-centered services, data support, maps, and a makerspace.
cards.access_notes: The library is in the Mackay Mines Building; consult library access information for current availability.

cards.title: DeLaMare Library Makerspace
cards.subtitle: First floor, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Take Makerspace 101 before planning a build, then use the 3D printing, scanning, cutting, milling, sewing, and hand-tool resources for a project.
cards.short_summary: A student makerspace supporting fabrication and project work with training required for users.
cards.evidence_claim: The DeLaMare FAQ says the Makerspace is open and free for all students and offers fabrication equipment; users must take Makerspace 101.
cards.access_notes: Open and free for students; complete the required Makerspace 101 Training Course before using the space.

cards.title: Mary B. Ansari Map Library
cards.subtitle: Basement, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Use this named collection when a project calls for maps or geospatial context; locate it through DeLaMare’s basement floor map before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A Nevada map collection within DeLaMare Library, alongside data and GIS support.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says the Mary B. Ansari Map Library contains more than 140,000 maps, and its floor map places it in DeLaMare's basement.
cards.source_title: DeLaMare Library floor maps | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located at the south end of DeLaMare's basement floor; check library access information before visiting.

cards.title: DeLaMare Audio Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Reserve ahead when recording audio with collaborators; the room has an isolation booth, microphones, editing software, and a workstation for production tasks.
cards.short_summary: A small recording room with an isolation booth and professional audio-editing setup.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries says the second-floor DeLaMare Audio Room has an isolation booth, two microphones, professional recording/editing software, and recommends reservations.
cards.source_title: Specialty tech spaces at DeLaMare | University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Online reservations are strongly recommended; the room is on DeLaMare’s second floor.

cards.title: DeLaMare Student Collaboration Room
cards.subtitle: DLM 202A, DeLaMare Science and Engineering Library
cards.notes: Book this named room when your team needs to talk through a project; reserve in advance rather than relying on an open study table.
cards.short_summary: A reservable DeLaMare room intended for student collaboration and group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The DeLaMare FAQ identifies Group Study Room 202A as reservable, and the quiet-spaces guide lists DLM 202A as the Student Collaboration Room.
cards.access_notes: Reservation is available in advance; room availability is not guaranteed without one.

cards.title: E. L. Wiegand Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Fitness and Recreational Sports, north campus
cards.notes: Use the open gym, track, fitness areas, or scheduled activities after confirming your membership and completing the required annual recreation waiver.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation center with courts, cardio and weight-training areas, track, and activity studios.
cards.evidence_claim: University Fitness and Recreational Sports lists basketball/volleyball courts, weightlifting and cardio areas, a running track, and activity studios at Wiegand Fitness Center.
cards.access_notes: An active membership and University ID are required to enter Fitness and Recreational Sports buildings; patrons must complete an annual waiver.
